general guideline covering EXS-027 (example 12) and this example

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all follow the same preceding event and are performed together, and a later step continues only after all of them are done: Model an opening parallel gateway after the preceding step, with one branch per listed activity, and close those branches with a joining parallel gateway before the next step. Do not chain the activities in sequence, and do not use an exclusive gateway to join them.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that while other parties carry out their own activities, one actor also readies or prepares a separate item, and a later step starts only once all of these items are ready

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description lists several activities that all belong to one stage, have no stated order between them, and a later step waits until every one of them has finished: Model each listed activity as its own task. Open the branches with a parallel gateway placed before the first of these tasks, and close them with a matching parallel gateway placed before the next step. Do not sequence the tasks unless the description states an order, and do not merge them into one task.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that while other parties carry out their work, one actor also performs a separate activity, and a later step continues only after that activity and the other work are finished

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that an activity may or may not take place (for example, 'may take place' or 'may occur'), so the activity is optional and its execution depends on circumstances the description leaves open: Model an exclusive gateway before the optional activity, with one outgoing flow into the activity and one skip flow that bypasses it. Place a second exclusive gateway after the activity that merges the activity path and the skip path before the next step. Do not model the optional activity as unconditional in the main sequence.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says that an actor may postpone a later activity when the actor has another piece of work (a stated condition), and the activity that follows the postponement must happen in every case afterwards

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that two or more activities run at the same time (joined by 'while' or 'and', or stated as simultaneous), and a later step starts only after all of them are finished: Model the concurrent activities as separate branches that start at one parallel gateway, with each activity in its own branch and placed in the lane of the participant who performs it. Close all branches with one matching parallel gateway placed before the later step. Do not sequence the concurrent activities one after another, do not omit an activity or merge it into another, and do not use an exclusive gateway, because it would choose one path while the description requires all of them to proceed.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that two or more activities run at the same time (joined by 'while' or 'and', or stated as simultaneous), and a later step starts only after all of them are finished
